title: PromptOps 2026 — AI Prompt Engineering Challenge
shortDescription: High-stakes competitive prompt engineering and agent workflow challenge testing LLM orchestration.
description: PromptOps 2026 is an intensive competitive prompt engineering challenge hosted by CIPHER, Department of Computer Science & Engineering. Students construct multi-stage system prompts, automate developer workflows, and evaluate model responses to solve complex computing tasks.

title: Google Summer of Code & LLM Engineering Workshop
shortDescription: Hands-on guide to open-source contributions, GSoC proposals, and LLM fine-tuning.
description: An interactive hands-on workshop led by senior mentors and open-source contributors. Participants learned the fundamentals of navigating open-source repositories, crafting competitive GSoC proposals, and deploying lightweight LLMs locally for developer tools.

title: Cybersecurity & Cloud Security Career Pathways
shortDescription: Expert breakdown of modern threat vectors, ethical hacking, and cloud defense strategies.
description: An insightful industry interaction focusing on offensive and defensive security practices. Industry speakers provided real-world insights into threat vectors, penetration testing tools, cloud infrastructure security, and career entryways for CSE undergraduates.

title: Lumière – The Annual Departmental Gala
shortDescription: The inaugural entry programme celebrating CSE achievements, culture, and council induction.
description: Lumière is the flagship welcoming gala of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering. The event brought together faculty, alumni, and students to celebrate academic milestones, showcase cultural performances, and formally inaugurate the incoming CIPHER executive council.
